name: Ecole de Monstre~Le desespoir de Toma
source:
Three months since Toma refused to become Mayako's boyfriend.
Since then, Toma has only been studying, training, helping, in short, he tries to do as much as possible not to think about Mayako.
Until a new professor arrives...
translation:
自斗真拒绝成为麻耶子的男友以来，已经过去3个月。
从那之后，斗真只顾学习、训练、帮忙，总之尽可能做一切事情，好让自己不去想麻耶子。
直到一位新教授到来……
